landing.title: Sobe e Desce
landing.subtitle: A Portuguese trick-taking game, online and in real time. Invite your friends, name the trump, and race down to zero.
how: Everyone gets 5 cards: 3, then the trump is named, then 2 more.
Discard up to the cap and draw again, or sit the round out (rules apply).
5 tricks. Follow suit, trump when void, and if you can climb, you must.
Each trick is -1. Playing and winning none costs +5. Hearts doubles everything.

party.eventCatalogHint: One of these appears at the start of every round. Suit, rank, pass count, and direction are drawn each time; the examples below show one possible result.

desce.name: Low card wins
desce.desc: Card rank is reversed: lower cards beat higher cards. If you can win by playing lower, you must. If you lead while holding the lowest trump, you must play it.

golden.name: Golden suit: {{suit}}
golden.desc: If {{suit}} is chosen as trump, tricks and the no-trick penalty count double this round.

lastTrick.name: Final trick ×5
lastTrick.desc: Whoever wins the fifth and final trick scores it as five tricks instead of one.

blankPays.name: Safe round
blankPays.desc: Nothing to lose: play as usual, and every outcome takes you down. Tricks count as always, and winning none subtracts the penalty instead of adding it.

noTrump.name: No trump
noTrump.desc: No trump suit this round. The trump phase is skipped and only the led suit can win.

openHands.name: Open hands
openHands.desc: Every hand is face up once the trump is settled.

allIn.name: All in
allIn.desc: Nobody may sit this round out.

asDealt.name: As dealt
asDealt.desc: Everyone must play with no discards: your five dealt cards are your hand for the round.

pass.name: Pass
pass.desc: After discarding, {{count}} random cards from each active player's hand go in the direction shown. Nobody chooses: the deal does.

swap.name: Swap hands
swap.desc: After everyone decides, a coin flip either rotates all active players’ hands or leaves them in place.

guardian.name: Secret guardian
guardian.desc: You secretly guard another player and see their hand. You receive their score change for the round instead of your own. Assignments are revealed at the end. Even tables only.

freeForAll.name: Free-for-all
freeForAll.desc: Play any card at any time: you do not have to follow suit or beat the current winner. Trump, then the led suit and normal card order, still decide each trick.

wildRank.name: Wild {{rank}}s
wildRank.desc: Play a {{rank}} at any time to beat every other card, including trump. If several are played, the first {{rank}} wins.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.desc: After each trick, every active player’s remaining cards move one seat to the left. You keep the tricks you already won.

market.name: Market
market.desc: After discarding, each active player contributes one card face up, then takes one back. The player with the highest score picks first.

dummy.name: Spare hand
dummy.desc: Up to seven extra cards are revealed. Each active player may swap one card with one of them, or skip. The player with the most points goes first.

faceUp.name: Revealed card
faceUp.desc: One random card in each active player’s hand stays visible to everyone until it is played.

inverted.name: Reverse scoring
inverted.desc: Tricks add points instead of subtracting them; winning none subtracts the usual penalty. Trump multipliers still apply.

team.name: Teams
team.desc: Random pairs, shown from the deal. Partners see each other's hands, and both take the pair's combined result. Even tables only.

nemesis.name: Secret nemesis
nemesis.desc: You are secretly given a target and take the opposite of their result: their loss is your gain. Who was after whom is revealed at the end.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: Your result is applied to the player on your left, and you receive the result of the player on your right.

musicalTricks.name: Musical tricks
musicalTricks.desc: After every trick but the last, the tricks already won move one seat to the left. Nobody keeps a lead for long.

robinHood.name: Robin Hood
robinHood.desc: At scoring, the player with the most points (last in the standings) and the player with the fewest (the leader) swap results, among those who played. The leader pays the round the trailer earned, and the other way round.

markedCard.name: Marked card: {{card}}
markedCard.desc: One dealt card is announced. Whoever takes the trick that holds the {{card}} pays {{points}} points on top. It stays where it was dealt: it cannot be discarded, and its holder cannot sit out.

fog.name: Fog
fog.desc: Every card is played face down: you only see your own. Nobody knows who took a trick until the round is scored, follow-suit does not apply, and the lead moves one seat left after each trick.

blindLead.name: Blind lead
blindLead.desc: The first card of every trick is played face down and revealed once everyone has followed. Followers may play anything; trump, then the led suit, still decides.

communism.name: Communism
communism.desc: What is yours is mine. After the discards, each player in turn is shown one to three random cards of a random player, takes one, and hands one of their own back face down.

voteTrump.name: Vote for trump
voteTrump.desc: Nobody names the trump: everyone votes in turn, secretly, and the suit with the most votes wins. Ties go to the earliest vote. Nobody is committed to the round by it.

peek.name: Peek
peek.desc: See a player's hand for the rest of the round.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: A player of your choice takes +{{points}} at the end of the round. Sitting out escapes it.

shield.name: Shield
shield.desc: Your own blank penalty this round is cancelled.

party.stashHint: The player furthest from 0 and anyone who pays a blank draw one at the end of every round. You hold at most {{max}}.
party.cursedPoints: +{{points}} at the end of the round
party.partnerHint: Your partner this round: you see each other's hands and share the result.
party.markedCardStays: The marked card stays in your hand
party.wardHint: You guard this player: you see their hand and receive their score change for the round.
party.notSwapped: The hands stayed where they were.
